drivers.title: Tankers hit mines and a projectile in the Strait of Hormuz; ceasefire odds fall
drivers.rationale: Several hulls hit in one day, confirmed by UKMTO -> war-risk premiums and tanker rates up -> shipping owners gain. BOAT is only +2% in 20 days, so this is not fully priced.

drivers.title: Tanker hits mines near Hormuz; Iran asserts control of the strait
drivers.rationale: Mines and Iranian threats against named shipowners -> higher war-risk insurance and freight rates through Hormuz -> tanker and shipping owners gain.

drivers.title: US warns allies of possible Iran strikes after midterms; Hormuz incidents continue
drivers.rationale: Drone shoot-down, a tanker explosion and Iranian threats against US-escorted transits -> war-risk premiums and freight rates stay high.

drivers.title: Houthi missile strike on Saudi Ras Tanura refinery; Saudi supply at three-decade low
drivers.rationale: Attack on the largest Saudi refinery plus IEA-reported supply low -> tighter crude and product balance -> producers up, airlines and cruise lines down. Brent already +11% in 20 days, so size kept moderate.

drivers.title: Tanker hits mines near Hormuz; Iran asserts control of the strait
drivers.rationale: Physical damage to shipping keeps the regional war premium in oil, defence and gold, and weighs on airlines.

drivers.title: Tankers hit mines and a projectile in the Strait of Hormuz; ceasefire odds fall
drivers.rationale: Attacks on shipping plus falling ceasefire odds and talk of a post-midterm campaign -> energy majors gain, airlines lose. Brent is already +12% in 20 days, so the size is moderate. This cuts against yesterday's low-confidence call that diplomacy would ease the oil premium; the money has moved toward escalation.

picks.name: Nvidia

drivers.title: Reports Nvidia's Huang was the target of a Chinese spy plot; DOJ scrutiny continues
drivers.rationale: Spy-plot headlines plus the antitrust inquiry -> political and China-access risk premium on Nvidia; the money (Polymarket -11 pts, QQQ -1.4%) shows sentiment turning. Builds on yesterday's DOJ call, so small.

drivers.title: DOJ inquiry into Nvidia's purchase of Hugging Face
drivers.rationale: An early-stage inquiry into one deal, not a case -> headline risk and a possible remedy, but small relative to Nvidia's earnings drivers.
